page_title: ESP 2-0 PAL | Espanyol v Las Palmas 24/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas) serves up a nice cross, but Joan Garcia punches the ball away.
90+4' The yellow card is received by Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas).
90+2' Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Las Palmas.

89' Alvaro Aguado (Espanyol) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the roof of the net, but Dinko Horkas shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
88' Diego Martin (Las Palmas) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
87' Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Joan Garcia, who smothers the ball.
85' Sergi Gomez (Espanyol) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
82' 2 - 0 Goal - 2:0! Javi Puado tees up Pere Milla (Espanyol) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom left corner and past Dinko Horkas.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Josito (Las Palmas) comes onto the pitch for Juanma Herzog.
80' The substitution has been made. Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) has replaced Jaime Mata.

80' What a poor attempt! Diego Martin (Las Palmas) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands. The ball goes out of play and Espanyol will have a goal kick.
79' Manolo Gonzalez decides to make a substitution. Urko Gonzalez will be replaced by Sergi Gomez (Espanyol).
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alvaro Aguado (Espanyol) replaces Roberto Fernandez Jaen.
78' The corner from Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas) is cleared away by the defence.
78' Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Las Palmas have a corner.
77' Alejandro Ruiz couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) and blew his whistle. Las Palmas will take a free kick.
75' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
73' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Dinko Horkas intercepts the ball.
73' Espanyol take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Dario Essugo departs the field of play to be replaced by Arturo Rodriguez (Las Palmas).
70' Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle. Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) commits a foul after dangerous play. Espanyol have been awarded a free kick.
69' Espanyol get a corner.

68' Javi Puado (Espanyol) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Espanyol.
66' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Javi Puado (Espanyol) gets booked.
65' 1 - 0 Goal! Javi Puado (Espanyol) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Dinko Horkas into the bottom right corner.
65' Javi Puado (Espanyol) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
64' Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul after Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Espanyol are given a huge opportunity to score - it's a penalty kick!
61' Diego Martinez has decided to substitute Sergio Viera Garcia and he is replaced by Diego Martin (Las Palmas).
60' It will be a substitution. Alex Kral (Espanyol) is ready to enter the pitch as Exposito walks off.
58' Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Dinko Horkas, who smothers the ball.
55' The attendance is 32511.
55' Pere Milla (Espanyol) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
53' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alejo Veliz (Espanyol) comes onto the pitch so that Jofre can be given a rest.
52' Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
51' Jaime Mata (Las Palmas) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save. It will be a corner kick for Las Palmas.
51' Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.

48' Dinko Horkas (Las Palmas) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Alejandro Ruiz no option but to blow his whistle. Espanyol are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
47' Pere Milla (Espanyol) misses the target from a promising position, sending the ball well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.
46' Diego Martinez makes a half-time substitution. Adnan Januzaj comes on in place of Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas).
46' Pol Lozano goes off the pitch and Pere Milla (Espanyol) comes on.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle, Las Palmas are awarded a corner kick.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' Scott McKenna (Las Palmas) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Espanyol earn a free kick.
42' Alejandro Ruiz has a clear sight and sees a foul from Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas). Espanyol are awarded a free kick.
42' Fernando Calero (Espanyol) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
41' A lofted cross from Jofre (Espanyol) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
40' Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Free kick. Espanyol will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
40' The referee points to the corner flag and Las Palmas will take a corner.
39' Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
38' Marvin (Las Palmas) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
36' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
35' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

35' Jofre (Espanyol) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort. The linesman points to the corner flag, Espanyol are going to take it.
34' Sergio Viera Garcia (Las Palmas) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
32' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
31' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Manuel Fuster (Las Palmas) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
31' Javi Puado (Espanyol) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
29' Manuel Fuster (Las Palmas) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
26' The referee blows for a cooling break.
26' The booking goes to Marvin (Las Palmas).
24' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) commits a rough challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for an infringement. Las Palmas get a free kick.
21' Jofre (Espanyol) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.

19' Juanma Herzog (Las Palmas) latches onto a precise lofted pass into the penalty area and produces a header at goal, but his attempt under the bar fails to beat Joan Garcia, who makes a sensational save.

18' Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Alejandro Ruiz has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Las Palmas.
15' That's unlucky! Javi Puado (Espanyol) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
15' Alejandro Ruiz shows a yellow card to Exposito (Espanyol), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
15' Las Palmas have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

14' Manuel Fuster (Las Palmas) latches on to a pin-point pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a daisy-cutter shot towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper produces an amazing acrobatic dive to deny him. The ball bounces off his gloves and hits the post. Las Palmas win a corner.

13' Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the left post is blocked by Joan Garcia, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
11' One of the players from Las Palmas times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
9' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) is first to the lofted pass but plants a header miles over the bar from close in. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Las Palmas.

8' Marvin (Las Palmas) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Alejandro Ruiz with no other option than to blow for a foul. Espanyol have a free kick.
5' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) sends a cross into the box, but Dinko Horkas comes off his line to gather the ball.
5' Jofre (Espanyol) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
3' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) is penalised for a foul. Alejandro Ruiz had a clear view and blows his whistle. Las Palmas are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
2' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Espanyol, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
1' A player from Las Palmas commits a rough challenge. Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. A free kick has been awarded to Espanyol.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Espanyol will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Alejandro Ruiz.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
